arStrings.szText: {icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}18{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Terror{/c}, {c_important}Shrine{/c} effects in {c_important}Helltide{/c} last {c_number}15{/c} seconds longer and grant {c_number}50%{/c} increased Movement Speed.
While empowered by a {c_important}Shrine{/c} in {c_important}Helltide{/c}, slain enemies grant double the progress to your {c_important}{b}{u}Threat Level{/c}{/b}{/u}.
